body.p: The Git History view shows the commit history, revision graph, commit details, and affected resources for the selected repository, branch, or resource.

section.title: Open Git History
section.p: To open the Git History view, use one of the following:

ul.li: Select Show current repository history from the Git Staging toolbar.
Go to Window Show View Git History .

section.title: Toolbar and Filter
section.p: Use the toolbar to control which commits are shown.

ul.li: Branch Chooser - Choose All branches, All local branches, Current branch, or Current local branch.
Link with Editor - Synchronizes the history with the selected editor. Enabled by default.
Text Filter - Filters commits by message, date, author, commit ID, branch name, or tag name.

section.title: History Table
section.p: The history table shows commits in rows. The graph column shows how commits are connected. The other columns show the commit message, date, author, and commit ID.
Right-click a commit row to access context menu actions. For a full list, see .
The table can also show an Uncommitted changes row. Select it to inspect working-copy changes that are not yet committed.
Select more than one commit to compare changes across a range of revisions. The lower panes show the boundary commits and the files changed in the selected range.

When you select two or more committed revisions, the lower panes compare the newest and oldest selected commits. The left pane identifies the compared revisions and the right pane lists all files changed between them.
Context menu actions in the changed-files list depend on the change type:

ul.li: Modified and renamed files: compare the newer version with the older version, or open the newer, older, or working-copy version.
Added files: open the newer version or, when the file still exists locally, the working-copy version.
Deleted files : open the older version.

section.p: If you select the Uncommitted changes row together with one or more committed revisions, the lower panes compare the current working tree with the oldest selected revision.

When a range comparison produces no differences, the changed-files pane shows No changes. When the Uncommitted changes row is selected by itself and there are no unstaged changes, the pane shows No unstaged changes.
When a merge, rebase, cherry-pick, or revert is in progress, the history view adds amber labels to the commits involved. For more information, see .

section.title: Commit Details Pane
section.p: The commit details pane shows the full commit ID, parent commit, author, date, committer, and commit message for the selected commit.

section.title: Affected Resources Pane
section.p: The affected resources pane lists the files changed by the selected commit. For context menu actions available in this pane, see .
